ui_skip_routes.reason: Template previews come from opengraph.githubassets.com through the web app's image optimizer. Inside the sealed network that lookup fails and Next.js logs the error as a multi-line object whose `code: 'ENOTFOUND'` line names no host, so the audit cannot attribute it to the allowed host and counts it as a resolver error. The page returns to the walk once the harness attributes such lines.

default_off.description: Nothing about statistics configured, in the container environment or the API's .env file (a fresh self-hosted installation): statistics are off by default, so the module is not loaded, no call, no Ever host looked up, every module route 404.

off_env_file.description: Statistics switched off ONLY in the API's .env file (mounted at the API's working directory), nothing about them in the container environment: the module is not loaded, no call, no Ever host looked up, every module route 404.
